title: QA feedback packet (replicant.qa-feedback/v1)
description: WS-05. Written by activity qa.classify when routing.decision is fix_loop, at tenants/<t>/jobs/<j>/steps/qa.c<cycle>.n<ordinal>/qa_report/feedback.json (artifact type qa_report). The context assembler (WS-04) stages it into the next implementer run's inputs and renders it into the task packet inside an untrusted-content block. Content is derived from the classified qa_report: only blocking findings plus up to 10 non-blocking ones, each with enough text for an agent that cannot open traces or images. Size ≤ 256 KiB so it fits a context budget line (WS-04 context-budget).

iteration.description: QA fix iteration this feedback starts (1-based).

instructions_ref.description: Langfuse prompt (pinned through the bundle) that frames this packet for the implementer. Replicant-authored text, not model output.

reproduce.description: Exact commands the implementer can run inside its own sandbox to reproduce, taken from the environment definition (never from model output).

diagnosis.description: Optional QA agent diagnosis (diagnose_failures task). Untrusted model output; quoted, labelled as such, and never used to lower severity.

previous_iterations.description: Test IDs that were blocking in earlier iterations of this cycle, with whether they now pass (detects fix oscillation).

evidence_summary.description: Replicant-generated sentence from attempts, e.g. 'failed 3/3 on the change, passed 3/3 on base'.

screenshot_path_in_inputs.description: Screenshot staged into the implementer's inputs (for multimodal CLIs), path relative to the inputs directory.
